verdict_logic.pass_condition: SUT responds with SupportedAppProtocolRes containing responseCode oK_SuccessfulNegotiation or oK_SuccessfulNegotiationWithMinorDeviation within timer expiry
verdict_logic.fail_condition: SUT responds with SupportedAppProtocolRes containing any responseCode other than oK_SuccessfulNegotiation or oK_SuccessfulNegotiationWithMinorDeviation, or sends an unexpected message type
verdict_logic.inconc_condition: Timer tc_V2G_SECC_Msg_Timer expires before receiving SupportedAppProtocolRes, or TCP/TLS connection is closed unexpectedly prior to response
